title: Passcode
description: Requires a passcode (or a local account password on a Mac) and sets how strong it must be.

allowSimple.title: Allow simple passcodes
allowSimple.description: Off blocks repeating or sequential passcodes such as 1111 or 1234.

forcePIN.title: Require a passcode
forcePIN.description: On makes the user set a passcode.

maxFailedAttempts.title: Maximum failed attempts
maxFailedAttempts.description: After this many wrong passcodes the device erases itself.

maxGracePeriod.title: Grace period (minutes)
maxGracePeriod.description: How long after locking the device unlocks without a passcode. 0 asks immediately.

maxInactivity.title: Auto-Lock (minutes)
maxInactivity.description: Longest the user can set Auto-Lock to.

maxPINAgeInDays.title: Maximum passcode age (days)
maxPINAgeInDays.description: Days before the user must change the passcode.

minComplexChars.title: Minimum symbols
minComplexChars.description: Minimum number of characters that are not a letter or number, such as & or #.

pinHistory.title: Passcode history
pinHistory.description: The new passcode must differ from this many previous ones.

requireAlphanumeric.title: Require letters
requireAlphanumeric.description: On requires at least one letter, not just numbers.
